methodology: Retrieved all 1420 known blocks from genesis through the recorded tip.
Deduplicated transactions by transaction ID and selected accepted transactions using the selected-parent-chain RPC.
Included the recorded virtual tip coinbase only after confirming its outputs in the node UTXO index.
Matched all three mining payout addresses to blocks explicitly recorded as found in the server miner log.
Summed accepted mining reward outputs and subtracted transaction fees calculated from transaction inputs and outputs.
Verified minted subsidies equal 1418 reward outputs at 20 NNN each and match circulating supply reported by both nodes.
Both servers use the same current mining address; their views of the same rewards are counted once.
